Our work / Project

Studio launch / From idea to working product

DrivewAI

Try an exterior change on a photo of your home.

Endcap helped take DrivewAI from the initial idea to a launched AI visualization product, with photo upload, image generation, comparisons, refinements, and downloads.

  • Product planning and design
  • Photo upload and AI generation
  • Before-and-after comparison
  • Refinements and downloads
  • Payment flow and launch

The starting point

Homeowners can collect photos of materials and finished projects, but it is harder to picture a specific change on their own home. They need a visual way to explore an idea before discussing the work.

Endcap’s role

We built the experience around an existing photo and a written request. The current product focuses on exterior changes such as driveways, walkways, and front steps.

The work

From idea to launch

  1. 01

    Start with a photo and a request

    We designed a simple entry point: upload an exterior photograph and describe the change. Suggested prompts help visitors start without filling out a long questionnaire.

  2. 02

    Generate, compare, and refine

    The workspace keeps the original photo available beside the generated options. Users can compare a direction, request a refinement, and return to the versions associated with that photo.

  3. 03

    Complete the customer journey

    We connected generation to accounts, a per-photo purchase, and image downloads. The result is a usable product flow from first preview to an image the customer can share.

The launched product

What it does today.

DrivewAI is live with an exterior-photo workflow. Customers can explore a change on their own home and download a concept to discuss with a contractor. The images are visual concepts, not construction plans or measurements.
